name: Fire-Roasted Peeled Red Bell Peppers (Skin & Seeds Removed)
whyItWorks: Roasting blisteringly chars the tough outer skin so it slides off cleanly, leaving only the soft, sweet, vitamin-C-rich inner pepper flesh. With skins and seeds removed, it is smooth, non-acidic, and easily digested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy jarred roasted red peppers packed in water (drain well) or roast whole peppers at home and peel completely. Add to sourdough sandwiches, rice, or mild pasta.
watchOuts: Verify all waxy skin shreds and seeds have been removed.
